Help

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know before you join.

What is The Stillroom?

A community for working professionals and work-from-home people: meet people in your city, talk honestly about work and life, join small events, and figure out what you actually want.

Is it free?

Joining is free, and so are your profile, meeting people, chat, forums and going to events. Hosting events is part of Premium (₹500 for 30 days, no auto-renew).

Who is it for?

Anyone who works — salaried professionals, remote and work-from-home people, freelancers, founders, people between jobs — who wants friends outside work. You need to be 18 or older.

How is it different from LinkedIn?

LinkedIn is for your career: networking, jobs and looking successful. The Stillroom is for the rest of your life: making friends nearby, talking honestly and switching off. No follower counts, no endless feed, no networking pitch.

How do I meet people near me?

Set your home city in Edit profile. Then browse Members and Events for your city, or say hello in the city Chat.

What kind of events happen?

Small, low-pressure meetups: coffee, walks, co-working sessions, board games and talks. Any member can join; Premium members can host.

Can I message anyone?

You can message people you’re connected with. Open someone’s profile and tap Connect — once they accept, you can message each other.

Who can see my profile?

Other signed-in members can see your profile. Your direct messages and your Clarity plan are not shown to other members.

What is Clarity?

A private, one-minute check-in. Choose what you want right now, put it in order, and pick one small step for your top priority. Tick it off when it’s done.

Someone is bothering me. What can I do?

Block them from their profile. They won’t be able to message you, and you won’t see them in Members. For anything serious, email support@thestillroom.site.

Is it safe to meet people in person?

Meet in public places, tell a friend where you’re going, and leave if anything feels off. Read our safety notes in the Terms.

What does Premium include?

Hosting events, a violet ✨ Premium tag with a glow on your messages, events and posts, and seeing who viewed your profile. ₹500 for 30 days, paid with UPI or card. See Premium.

How do I delete my account?

Email support@thestillroom.site from the address you signed up with and we’ll delete your account and data.

Still have a question? Email support@thestillroom.site.
